Mega Blaziken EX Premium Collection
products.note: Two packs each of Primal Clash, Roaring Skies, Ancient Origins and BREAKthrough, a jumbo card, a coin and a playmat in the real box; only the BREAKthrough packs are shown. It also held Blaziken-EX XY54, filed under the Hoenn Power Tin in Roaring Skies.

products.name: Mega Swampert EX Premium Collection
products.note: Two packs each of Primal Clash, Roaring Skies, Ancient Origins and BREAKthrough, a jumbo card, a coin and a playmat in the real box; only the BREAKthrough packs are shown. It also held Swampert-EX XY55, filed under the Hoenn Power Tin in Roaring Skies.

products.name: Pikachu EX Legendary Collection
products.note: Two BREAKthrough, one Ancient Origins, one Roaring Skies and one Primal Clash pack and a Pikachu pin in the real box, with five full-art legendaries and the EX; only the BREAKthrough packs are shown. Sources disagree on which box holds which five.

products.name: Hoopa EX Legendary Collection
